title: Articles
lede: Prototype history of Pittsburgh Coke & Chemical, the rest of the POHC line, and the railroads of the Chartiers Valley.

items.title: Neville Island coke, cement, and chemical history
items.blurb: American Steel & Wire through Davison, PC&C, Shenango, Calgon, Kosmos, and Aristech — pig iron to about 1990–91, coke to 2016.

items.title: POHC line industries, McKees Rocks to Washington
items.blurb: Pressed Steel Car, Kirwan Heights, Canonsburg pottery and transformers, Washington Steel, and the other plants along Chartiers Creek.

items.title: Railroads of the Chartiers Valley
items.blurb: Chartiers Branch and PC&Y as two different railroads, then PIR and POHC, plus the Class I connections around McKees Rocks and Duff Junction.

items.title: Pittsburgh Coke & Chemical doubles pig iron (1951)
items.blurb: New York Times financial page, 6 July 1951: rights offering to raise Neville Island pig iron from 300,000 to 600,000 net tons a year.

items.blurb: How HART uses STS for car forwarding and operations.
